constraints.why: the datatype IRI matches but the literal is ill-typed. This is precisely what a shape-driven form can still emit: the widget stamps the declared datatype, the user supplies the lexical form.

parser.spec: Turtle §6.5 / RDF 1.1 Concepts §3.2: an IRI that does not satisfy the IRIREF production is a syntax error the parser must report; it is never a triple the parser may quietly discard.
parser.why: a well-formed IRI; the control case.

parser.spec: Turtle §6.5 / RDF 1.1 Concepts §3.2: an IRI that does not satisfy the IRIREF production is a syntax error the parser must report; it is never a triple the parser may quietly discard.
parser.why: '#' is not excluded by the Turtle IRIREF production, so this parses; it is not a valid RFC 3987 IRI, so a parser may reject it. Silently dropping the triple is the one answer that is not available.

parser.spec: Turtle §6.5 / RDF 1.1 Concepts §3.2: an IRI that does not satisfy the IRIREF production is a syntax error the parser must report; it is never a triple the parser may quietly discard.
parser.why: '|' IS excluded by the Turtle IRIREF production, so this is a syntax error and a conformant parser must report it.
